snippet.title: There is NO PLAN B - Episode 0 Official Trailer (CV: Sayaka Senbongi)
snippet.description:
A cyberpunk hikikomori detective adventure There is NO PLAN B - Episode 0 Play NOW!!
Steam Demo : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2928230/

Enter the year 2070 as you step into the shoes of total recluse Detective B to solve a case of social homicide within a cyberpunk world.
But what is "social homicide" exactly...?

We hope our game will be one that you all can enjoy and pour out your love for. If you have any questions or feedback, please reach out by email anytime at contact@superwavestudio.com
